[/b][b]About:[/b]A rare and enigmatic relative of the Waterside Flamingo, the Veilwater Flamingo carries an air of quiet devotion. Cloaked in dark hues with subtle shimmer, they move gracefully along the water’s edge — a hauntingly serene presence that feels almost ritualistic.
•[b] Seasonal Availability: [/b]Only sold in the summer at Marnie’s Ranch
•[b] Farm Buildings:[/b] Requires a barn
•[b] Habitat:[/b] Drawn to calm waters — keep them near ponds or rivers to watch their reflective strolls
•[b] Special Produce:[/b] Like their brighter kin, Veilwater Flamingos deliver shrimp and crab, offering a touch of mystery to your seafood harvests. They also lay eggs, which can be hatched using an Ostrich Incubator

Once, your lawn flamingo was a simple decoration. Now, it’s something sacred — a living echo of the waters it watches over.
